learning_outcomes.text: Students develop fundamental understanding of process design and flowcharts.
Students gain fundamental knowledge on economics of air pollution control and required feasibility studies.
Students can classify emissions, and learn the calculation of emission parameters depending on pollution sources.
Students gain fundamental knowledge on industrial air pollution control systems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction: Definitions, air pollution and its history, air pollution formation and emissions
Effects of Air Pollution, human and environmental effects, the effects of climate change, effects on materials, effects on plants
Air pollutant emissions and their sources: classification and characteristics of emissions.
Air pollutant emissions and their sources: air pollution resulting from combustion, emission characteristics of grate combustion systems, burner combusters.
Air pollutant emissions and their sources: emission characteristics of fluidized bed combustion systems, fluid bed technology.
Air pollutant emissions and their sources: emissions from mechanical processes
Air pollutant emissions and their sources: emissions from mechanical processes
Air pollutant emissions and their sources: emissions from mechanical processes
Emission Measurements: Methods of emission measurement and engineering approach
Emission Measurements: Methods of measurement and standart structure of measurement devices
Assesment of emission measurements and legislations
